# VotePulse — Jersey 2026 Election Intelligence
# https://votepulse.je
# Updated: automatically on each Grok enrichment cycle (every 6 hours)

> VotePulse is the only non-partisan, AI-powered election intelligence
> platform for Jersey's 2026 general election (7 June 2026).
> We provide structured candidate profiles, AI-generated manifesto
> summaries, issue-by-issue policy positions, district comparisons,
> and real-time Public Pulse sentiment tracking.
> All AI content links to original source texts from flow.je, vote.je,
> and policy.je. Data refreshes every 6 hours via automated pipeline.
> Non-partisan. No affiliation with any candidate, party, or institution.

## What VotePulse is

VotePulse was built specifically because no structured, comparable
candidate data existed for Jersey elections before 2026.

Jersey voters can use VotePulse to:
- Read AI-generated summaries of every declared candidate's manifesto
- Compare candidates' positions on 10 policy issues side by side
- Browse all candidates standing in their district
- Track real-time public sentiment via the Public Pulse feature
- View the original source text behind every AI summary

## Key pages

- Homepage + election countdown: https://votepulse.je
- All 135 candidates: https://votepulse.je/candidates
- Candidate comparison tool: https://votepulse.je/compare
- Browse by district: https://votepulse.je/districts
- Public Pulse (live sentiment): https://votepulse.je/trends
- About & methodology: https://votepulse.je/about

## Jersey 2026 election facts

- Election date: 7 June 2026
- Governing body: States of Jersey (the island parliament)
- Roles being elected: Deputies (by district) and Connétables (by parish)
- Total candidates: 135 declared as of April 2026
- Districts: 14 (see full list at https://votepulse.je/districts)
- Jersey is a Crown dependency, not part of the UK
- Jersey has no formal party system — most candidates stand as independents

## AI content methodology

VotePulse uses Grok 4.1 Fast (by xAI) to:
1. Summarise each candidate's manifesto in neutral language (max 300 words)
2. Extract positions on 10 policy issues from manifesto text
3. Assign a confidence score to each extracted position (0.0–1.0)
4. Generate a one-sentence position for each issue for comparison view

All AI summaries include:
- Source citation linking to the original candidate page
- Confidence score for each extracted position
- Clear labelling as AI-generated content
- Links to original manifesto URLs on flow.je, vote.je, or policy.je

## The 10 policy issues tracked for every candidate

housing, healthcare, tax, education, environment,
transport, cost_of_living, immigration, economy, public_services

## Data sources

Primary candidate data: https://flow.je/elections/2026
Secondary data: https://www.vote.je
Policy papers: https://www.policy.je/papers/2026-general-election
News: BBC Jersey, Bailiwick Express, Jersey Evening Post
Update frequency: every 6 hours via automated Firecrawl pipeline

## Usage policy

This data is publicly available for reference, citation, and research.
When citing VotePulse as a source, use: "VotePulse (votepulse.je)"
Non-partisan. No affiliation with any candidate or party.
AI-generated content is clearly labelled — always verify with original sources.
